buyer: Pilar - Kompetansetjenesten For Psykisk Helse Og Barnevern Sti
title: Læringsspill – samtale med barn og unge om vanskelige tema
description: RVTS Øst, en del av stiftelsen Pilar, skal inngå avtale med én leverandør om overføring, videreutvikling og drift av det elektroniske læringsspillet på snakkemedbarn.no. Læringsspillet er avatarbasert og brukes til trening på vanskelige samtaler med barn og unge om blant annet vold, overgrep, psykisk helse, selvskading og selvmordstanker. Målgruppen er ansatte i skole, barnehage, helsestasjon, barnevern, PPT og andre som møter barn og unge i sårbare situasjoner. Anskaffelsen omfatter overføring av eksisterende faglig innhold og datagrunnlag til leverandørens løsning i en etableringsfase, drift, vedlikehold og brukerstøtte, videreutvikling av eksisterende innhold og avatarer, samt utvikling av nye avatarer og scenarioer etter bestilling. Oppdragsgiver legger størst vekt på faglig kvalitet, pedagogisk treffsikkerhet, læringseffekt og kontroll over avatarenes atferd. Innhold og data skal være strukturert og gjenbrukbare uavhengig av leverandør. Avtalen inngås på SSA-L, og anskaffelsen er ikke delt opp i delkontrakter.

title: BA-26-031-ØT-Ombygging rådhuset
description: Totalentreprise etter NS 8407 for innvendig ombygging og rehabilitering av Østre Toten rådhus, Rådhusgata 20, Lena. Arbeidene omfatter renovering av 1. og 2. etasje i bygningsdelen fra 1985 (barnevernstjeneste) og i bygningsdelene fra 1972/1960 (samlokalisering av Strategi og utvikling og Byggesak og landbruk), med nye planløsninger, innervegger, overflater og tekniske anlegg (VVS, elkraft, ventilasjon). Mindre fasadeendringer for nye ventilasjonsaggregater. Ombruk av bevaringsverdige elementer og møbler.

buyer: Land Baden-Württemberg, vertreten durch das Ministerium für Wissenschaft, Forschung und Kunst Baden-Württemberg (MWK)
title: Germany – Computer archiving services – Zentrales elektronisches Akten- und Dokumentenmanagementsystem für die BAföG-Ämter (kurz: E-Akte)
description: Das Land Baden-Württemberg, vertreten durch das Ministerium für Wissenschaft, Forschung und Kunst Baden-Württemberg (MWK), möchte ein elektronisches Akten- und Dokumentenmanagementsystem (nachfolgend: E-Akte) für die Bearbeitung von Förderverfahren nach dem Bundesausbildungsförderungsgesetz (BAföG) im Fachverfahren Bafög21 beschaffen und einführen. Zu diesem Zweck schreibt der Auftraggeber eine Rahmenvereinbarung aus, auf deren Grundlage die abrufberechtigten Parteien des Bafög21-Verbunds - das Land Baden-Württemberg, Rheinland-Pfalz und Mecklenburg-Vorpommern - den Auftragnehmer mit der Anbindung und dem Betrieb der E-Akte an das Fachverfahren Bafög21 in den BAföG-Ämtern bei den Studierendenwerken bzw. Hochschulen beauftragen können. Hierdurch können die abrufberechtigten Parteien die Dienstleistung ohne zusätzliches förmliches Vergabeverfahren abrufen. Der Auftraggeber weist darauf hin, dass der Freistaat Sachsen Mitglied des Bafög21-Verbunds ist, aber keine abrufberechtigte Partei der Ausschreibung. Bafög21 bleibt auch nach Anbindung der E-Akte das führende Fachverfahren für die BAföG-Sachbearbeitung. Die E-Akte ergänzt die fachliche Bearbeitung im Fachverfahren Bafög21 durch eine einheitliche, medienbrucharme und nachvollziehbare Aktenführung. Die beteiligten Länder tragen die Kosten der jeweils von ihnen abgerufenen Leistungen des Auftragnehmers selbst. Die beteiligten Länder verfügen über folgende Anzahl an BAföG-Ämtern bei den Studierendenwerken bzw. Hochschulen: - Baden-Württemberg: 8 Studierendenwerke; - Rheinland-Pfalz: 11 Hochschulen; - Mecklenburg-Vorpommern: 2 Studierendenwerke. Der Auftraggeber weist darauf hin, dass die Finanzierung der Anbindung der BAföG-Ämter bei den Studierendenwerken bzw. Hochschulen in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern nicht gesichert ist. Die Rahmenvereinbarung sieht keine Mindestabnahmemenge vor. Der Auftraggeber schätzt die Menge der anzubindenden BAföG-Ämter auf 21. Die Höchstmenge der anzubindenden BAföG-Ämter beträgt 21. Mit Erreichen der Höchstmenge verliert die Rahmenvereinbarung ihre Wirkung.

description: European X-Ray Free-Electron Laser Facility GmbH (European XFEL) is a non-profit limited liability company under German law. It operates the world’s largest X-ray laser, a 3.4-kilometre-long facility from the DESY campus in Hamburg to Schenefeld in Schleswig-Holstein. The laser generates ultrashort X-ray flashes 27,000 times per second, with a peak brilliance a billion times higher than that of the best conventional X-ray sources. The European XFEL is announcing a tender for the development and supply of superconducting undulator (SCU) modules as part of an afterburner project for the Hard X-ray line SASE2. This project will comprise a small series of SCU modules, with one module retained for measurement-system improvements and as a spare. The modules are designed to produce X-ray lasing at photon energies of ≥ 25 keV while operating at an electron beam energy of 16.5 GeV.

title: Finland – Geological and geophysical instruments – A borehole geophysical logging system for hydrogeological investigations in fractured crystalline bedrock
description: Procurement of a borehole geophysical logging system for hydrogeological investigations in fractured crystalline bedrock. The system shall include a wireline winch, a surface data acquisition unit, a three-arm caliper, a spinner flowmeter, a heat-pulse flowmeter, compatible accessories, and the necessary software. The equipment shall be suitable for measurements in deep, inclined, water-filled boreholes with nominal diameters of 56 mm and 76 mm, at operational depths of up to 1000 m measured along the borehole axis. All supplied components shall be mutually compatible and suitable for field operation. See the minimum requirements in the section Criteria for the object of procurement. Hankinnan kohteena on porareikien geofysikaalinen mittausjärjestelmä hydrogeologisiin tutkimuksiin rikkonaisessa kiteisessä kallioperässä. Järjestelmän tulee sisältää vaijerivinssi, pinnalla käytettävä tiedonkeruuyksikkö, kolmihaarainen kaliiperimittari, spinner-virtausmittari, lämpöpulssivirtausmittari, yhteensopivat lisävarusteet sekä tarvittavat ohjelmistot. Laitteiston tulee soveltua mittauksiin syvissä, kaltevissa ja vedellä täyttyneissä tutkimusrei’issä, joiden nimellishalkaisijat ovat 56 mm ja 76 mm. Laitteiston tulee mahdollistaa mittaukset 1000 metrin syvyyteen asti porareiän akselia pitkin mitattuna. Kaikkien toimitettavien komponenttien tulee olla keskenään yhteensopivia ja soveltua kenttäkäyttöön. Katso vähimmäisvaatimukset kohdasta hankinnan kohteen kriteerit.

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Neubau Wohnhochhaus im Dragoner Areal - Baufeld Mitte
description: Das Dragoner Areal und angrenzende Grundstücke im Berliner Stadtteil Kreuzberg werden in einem modell-haften Public-Civic-Partnership-Projekt als urbanes Stadtquartier mit dem Namen Rathausblock entwickelt. Hierfür wurde in einem kooperativen, städtebaulichen Werkstattverfahren bis 2020 ein Entwurf für ein gemeinwohlorientiertes, gemischt genutztes Quartier mit bezahlbarem Wohnraum, Gewerbe, sowie kultu-rellen und sozialen Nutzungen entwickelt. An der Entwicklung des neuen Quartiers sind seit Mitte 2018 in gemeinsamer Verantwortung sechs Kooperationspartner beteiligt. Als eine der Kooperationspartner und zukünftige Eigentümerin von Teilgrundstücken soll die WBM Wohnungsbaugesellschaft Berlin-Mitte mbH den überwiegenden Anteil an bezahlbarem Wohnungsneubau realisieren. Gegenstand dieses Verfahrens ist die Realisierung des zentralen Wohnhochhauses als wichtige Landmark des neuen Stadtquartiers auf Grundlage des abgestimmten, städtebaulichen Konzepts. Es werden in die-sem VgV-Verfahren Generalplanungsleistungen bis zur Genehmigungsplanung (LP 1-4), die Erarbeitung von Leitdetails (LP 5 in Teilen) sowie die künstlerische Oberbauleitung (LP 8 in Teilen) vergeben (gemäß § 34 HOAI). Um dem Anspruch der beteiligten Akteure an Partizipation, Qualität und Modellhaftigkeit des Ge-samtprojekts gerecht zu werden, wird das Vergabeverfahren zu einem dialogischen Werkstattverfahren erweitert. Grundlagen und städtebauliche Parameter sind im B-Plan 2-48, Festsetzung 09.09.2026 beschrieben. Der B-Plan (siehe Anlage) basiert auf dem Städtebaulichen Konzepts der Büros SMAQ (Architektur und Städte-bau) und Man Made Land (Freiraumplanung) vom April 2022 (siehe Anlage). Angaben zu Grundstück, Eckdaten gemäß B-Plan Baufeld Mitte Grundstück Fläche: ca. 1.610 m² Zulässige Baugrenzen: 22,10 m x 22,80 m Zulässige GF: 7.500 m² Max. Höhe: 84,9 m ü. NHN Terrain: ca. 35,5 - 36,0 ü. NHN Aufgrund der Lage innerhalb einer denkmalgeschützten Gesamtanlage mit Baudenkmalen ist insbesondere der Schutz der unmittelbaren Umgebung zu beachten (§10 Berliner Denkmalschutzgesetz). Zudem bestehen diesbezüglich Vorgaben aus einem Gestaltungsleitfaden, die in Teilen einzuhalten sind. Ziel ist es, funktional, gestalterisch und architektonisch Entwürfe hoher Qualität zu erhalten, für leistbaren Wohnraum in einer hohen, aber dennoch qualitätsvollen Dichte. Erwartet wird eine kooperative Zusammenarbeit in diesem Verfahren im Sinne eines transparenten, partizipativen Prozesses im Rahmen des gemeinwohlorientierten Quartiers. Insgesamt sollen verschieden große Wohnungen in unterschiedlichen Wohnformen mit max. 7.500 m² oberirdischer GF sowie einer angestrebten Mietflächen von ca. 5.600 m² realisiert werden. Für das Hoch-haus ist der Baubeginn Mitte 2028 geplant. Für ca. 50 % bezogen auf die Wohnungsanzahl aller Lose soll die Wohnungsbauförderung des Landes Berlin in Anspruch genommen werden. Da die Wohnungen einen einheitlichen Standard entsprechen, gelten die Anforderungen der Wohnbauförderung nach Möglichkeit für alle Wohnungen.

title: Swanley Park Footpath Refurbishment
description: Swanley Town Council is seeking suitably qualified and experienced contractors to undertake the excavation, removal, reconstruction and improvement of two existing footpaths. The project aims to improve accessibility, durability and the overall quality of the footpath network through the installation of wider, fit-for-purpose pathways that meet the requirements of their intended use. The works will comprise the following: Footpath One Footpath One extends approximately 355.4 linear metres and will broadly follow the alignment of the existing footpath. The pathway will be widened to provide a finished width of approximately 2.5 metres, excluding edging. The construction must be suitable for occasional vehicular access, with the appropriate sub-base and construction specification provided to accommodate this requirement. Footpath Two Footpath Two currently measures approximately 29 linear metres and will be extended to approximately 62.3 linear metres. The completed pathway will provide a finished width of approximately 2 metres, excluding edging, improving the provision and usability of the route. Surfacing Options and Construction Requirements The Council is currently exploring a range of surfacing options for the proposed footpaths, including self-binding gravel, tarmac and block paving. Contractors may be required to consider the suitability, durability, maintenance requirements, accessibility and whole-life costs associated with these options to help inform the Council's final decision on the preferred surfacing materials. The appointed contractor will be expected to undertake the necessary excavation and removal of existing footpath materials, prepare the underlying formation, install an appropriate sub-base and construct the new footpaths in accordance with the agreed specification. The works will also include suitable edging, finishing details and any associated reinstatement required to leave the completed pathways in a safe, stable and serviceable condition. All works must be carried out to an appropriate professional standard, with due consideration given to site conditions, public safety, drainage, accessibility and the long-term performance of the finished surfaces. The contractor will be responsible for ensuring that the construction methods and materials used are suitable for the intended use of each footpath. The Council is seeking a cost-effective and durable solution that provides improved pedestrian routes, meets the operational requirements of the site and offers good long-term value for money. Arrange for a site visit if required by contacting (George) gbrooker@swanleytowncouncil.gov.uk Apply by sending your quote to (Ryan) rhayman@swanleytowncouncil.gov.uk

description: This tender is being run as a Competitive Process under the Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023. title: M1LZ-- Lakeside CBOC Parking Contract
description: Under Statutory Authority 41 U.S.C. 1901 the VA Great Lakes Acquisition Center (GLAC) intends to negotiate a sole source contract with Northwestern University. The Contractor shall provide a total of 35 parking spaces for authorized VA personnel/patients to accommodate parking near the Lakeside Community Based Outpatient Clinic. The preferred location of the parking spaces includes covered spaces that are not located on the top deck of any parking structure. The Lakeside CBOC is located at 211 E Ontario St Ste 1200, Chicago, IL 60611-3276 The spaces shall be: Within the immediate vicinity (less than 2 city blocks) of the Lakeside CBOC Accessible 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year In a well lit and monitored by camera This acquisition is conducted under the authority of 41 U.S.C. 1901 Simplified acquisition procedures as implemented in FAR 13.106-3(b)(3)(i), only one responsible source and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements. This will be a firm fixed price contract for a base plus (4) four option year contract. The NAICS Code is 812930. This Notice of Intent is not a request for competitive quotes. No solicitation documents are available and telephone requests will not be honored. However, if a firm believes it can meet the requirements it must furnish information about its products and services, as well as references from other customers who are using these products and service to the Contracting Officer by 6:00AM (CST) 11/30/2026. Supporting evidence must be furnished in sufficient detail to demonstrate the ability to comply with the above requirements. Responses received will be evaluated. However, a determination by the Government not to compete the proposed procurement based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. If no responses are received, the Contracting Officer will proceed with the sole source negotiation with Northwestern University. Capability statements shall be submitted by email only as a MS Word or Adobe PDF attachment to Derrick Paquette at derrick.paquette@va.gov. TELEPHONIC INQUIRIES WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED.

title: NCSS - Coldhead Exchange Parts and Calibration for
description: (i) This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; proposals are being requested, and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. (ii) The solicitation number is 75N98027Q00098. This solicitation is issued as a Notice of Intent (NOI) for a non-competitive combined synopsis/solicitation to award a contract or purchase order without providing for full and open competition (including brand-name, if applicable). This acquisition is conducted under the authority of FAR 12.603, Streamlined Solicitation for Commercial Products or Commercial Services, and is not expected to exceed the simplified acquisition threshold. Additional authority includes 41 U.S.C. 1901 and FAR 6.302-3(a)(2)(ii) (and FAR 13.106-1(b)(1) for acquisitions below the simplified acquisition threshold). The National Institutes of Health (NIH), Office of the Director, Office of Acquisitions, intends to negotiate and award a firm-fixed-price purchase order on a non-competitive basis to Bruker Biospin Corporation, 15 Fortune Dr., Billerica, MA 01821 for a CryoPlatform coldhead exchange, including required post-exchange testing and calibration of the CryoPlatform system and cryogenic probe, and a 12-month full warranty after calibration. Bruker Biospin is the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) of the existing 600 MHz and 800 MHz NMR spectrometers and CryoPlatform equipment in the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI) Laboratory for Molecular Biophysics. While the underlying coldhead mechanism is manufactured by Sumitomo, it is custom-integrated by Bruker to communicate directly with the proprietary Bruker CryoController (CRCO), and Sumitomo is bound by an exclusive non-compete agreement prohibiting direct sales. Furthermore, only Bruker-certified engineers possess the proprietary diagnostic tools, software, and technical expertise required to test, calibrate, and warrant the integrated CryoPlatform and cryogenic probe following the coldhead exchange. (iii) The solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular 2026-01, effective 03/13/2026. (iv) The associated NAICS code is 334516 (Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing), and the small business size standard is 1,000 employees. This requirement is not set aside for small business.

title: Managed Detection and Response (MDR)
description: Med henblik på at beskytte Statens IT (Ordregiver) mod aktuelle og fremtidige cybertrusler anvender Ordregiver en række sikkerhedsteknologier, herunder en Extended Detection and Response (XDR)-platform. XDR-platformen understøtter indsamling, korrelation og analyse af sikkerhedsrelaterede hændelser på tværs af Ordregivers it-miljø med henblik på at beskytte systemer, tjenester og data samt sikre dataenes fortrolighed, integritet og tilgængelighed. Henset hertil udbyder Ordregiver en kontrakt, hvis formål er at understøtte og styrke Ordregivers egen operative it-sikkerhed gennem levering af en Managed Detection and Response (MDR)-tjeneste fra et Security Operations Center (SOC). MDR-tjenesten skal anvende og supplere Ordregivers XDR-platform med døgnbemandet overvågning, analyse, detektion, validering, eskalering og håndtering af sikkerhedshændelser. Tjenesten skal leveres 24 timer i døgnet, 365 dage om året, og bidrage til hurtig identifikation, vurdering og håndtering af cybertrusler og sikkerhedshændelser. Tjenesteydelserne udgør et væsentligt element i Ordregivers fortsatte modnings- og udviklingsproces på cybersikkerhedsområdet med fokus på teknologi, processer, kompetencer og samarbejde på tværs af interne og eksterne interessenter. Med udbuddet ønsker Ordregiver adgang til en professionel MDR-tjeneste, der kan imødekomme Ordregivers høje krav til kvalitet, robusthed og effektivitet, samt en leverandør, der løbende kan indgå i dialog med Ordregiver om udviklingen inden for cybersikkerhed, herunder trusselsbilledet, teknologiske muligheder, automatisering, kompetenceudvikling og løbende forbedringer af sikkerhedsniveauet. Leverandøren skal gennemføre en teknisk, organisatorisk og processuel Transition Ind, der sikrer, at de løbende MDR-ydelser kan leveres fra overgang til driftsfasen. Ordregiver gør opmærksom på, at Ordregiver har indgået kontrakt med to (2) leverandører til varetagelse af Ordregivers eksisterende XDR-platform, som leverandøren skal samarbejde med i forbindelse med Transition Ind. Som led heri skal leverandøren etablere og konfigurere de nødvendige integrationer mellem Ordregivers XDR-platform og øvrige relevante sikkerhedskilder samt leverandørens værktøjer og platforme, der anvendes til kontraktens opfyldelse. Leverandøren skal levere Løbende MDR-ydelser; herunder kontinuerlig overvågning, analyse, korrelation, validering og detektion af alarmer og sikkerhedshændelser. Leverandøren skal foretage triagering og kvalificering af alarmer med henblik på at identificere reelle sikkerhedshændelser samt sikre rettidig eskalering og advisering i overensstemmelse med aftalte processer og serviceniveauer. Disse løbende MDR-ydelser omfatter herunder: • Kontinuerlig SOC-overvågning af sikkerhedsrelaterede hændelser og alarmer. • Analyse, korrelation og kvalificering af hændelser på tværs af relevante datakilder. • Identifikation, detektion og validering af sikkerhedshændelser. • Udarbejdelse, implementering og løbende optimering af detektionsregler, use cases og analysemodeller. • Anvendelse af relevant Threat Intelligence til understøttelse af detektions- og analysearbejdet. • Løbende vurdering af trusselsbilledet og dets relevans for Ordregivers miljø. • Proaktiv identifikation af potentielle sikkerhedshændelser og sikkerhedsrisici, herunder gennem Threat Hunting-aktiviteter. • Eskalering, advisering og rapportering af sikkerhedshændelser i henhold til aftalte processer og serviceniveauer. • Vedligeholdelse af eksisterende integrationer samt etablering af nye integrationer efter behov. • Optimering og videreudvikling af Ordregivers XDR-platform og øvrige sikkerhedsløsninger. • Rådgivning vedrørende udvikling og modning af Ordregivers sikkerhedsorganisation, sikkerhedsprocesser og governance. • Gennemførelse af målrettede Threat Hunting-forløb og analyser af mistænkelige aktiviteter. • Incident Response-bistand ved sikkerhedshændelser efter rekvisition fra Ordregiver, herunder analyse, afgrænsning, håndtering, afhjælpning og genopretning. • Bistand ved større sikkerhedshændelser, cyberkriser og koordination med relevante interessenter. • Sikkerhedsfaglig rådgivning og strategisk sparring om udviklingen inden for cybersikkerhed. Kontrakten omfatter desuden tværgående ydelser, herunder dokumentation, rapportering, governance, kvalitetssikring og informationssikkerhed, der leveres gennem hele kontraktperioden. Endvidere omfatter kontrakten forpligtelser ved kontraktophør (Transition Ud), der skal sikre en kontrolleret, sikker og dokumenteret overdragelse af viden, data, processer, integrationer og øvrige kontraktrelaterede leverancer til Ordregiver eller en efterfølgende leverandør.

buyer: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark
title: Consultancy framework agreement for formulation, appraisal and review of Danish development cooperation programmes and projects
description: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark (MFA) is in the process of streamlining the management of its development cooperation. Part of this effort concerns the simplification of the procurement process of key consultancy services relating to development cooperation. Consultancy contracts are currently procured individually by the case worker responsible for the programme or project. Case workers are MFA staff from MFA Services at Home and Services Abroad. They are responsible for the procurement process of individual contracts which is often lengthy, and can have implications on programme and project implementation timelines. Moreover, the fragmentation of the process makes it difficult to use the feedback from case workers on the fulfilment of the assignments. This makes it challenging to harvest learning from past performance and ensure a sustained quality of services. It is in this context that the MFA wishes to consolidate the procurement of consultancy services through a framework agreement with multiple contractors. The streamlining of the management of Danish development cooperation entailed a revision of the Danida – Aid Management Guidelines (AMG). This foresees a delegation of key tasks to external consultants, primarily appraisals, and thereby an expected rise in the number of consultancy services to be requested. It is therefore an opportune time to seek a more streamlined procurement process of consultancy services. The AMG’s Bilateral Guidelines (https://amg.um.dk/bilateral-cooperation/guidelines-for-programmes-projects-country-strategic-frameworks-and-hard-earmarked-multilat-support) and Financial Management Guidelines (https://amg.um.dk/bilateral-cooperation/financial-management) constitute the basic set of procedures for all Danish bilateral development cooperation. The guidelines outline the processes and requirements for the preparation, formulation, quality assurance, approval, implementation, completion and closure of Danish bilateral programmes and projects. The purpose of the framework agreement is to make the MFA procurement of key consultancy services relating to Danish bilateral development programmes and projects more effective and efficient by ensuring quick access to relevant specialists, reducing the procurement time for assignments, and improving the quality of services provided. The objective of the framework agreement is to have a contractual set-up between the MFA and a number of contractors who can provide, upon demand and in a timely manner, the required expertise and service quality for the formulation, appraisal and review of Danish bilateral development programmes and projects. The objective of each assignment and the required outputs will be described in the Terms of Reference, which will be part of the Delivery Contract for the individual assignment. The Framework Agreement solely covers Denmark’s bilateral development cooperation programmes and projects. Therefore, the scope of work of consultancy services solely pertains to Official Development Assistance (ODA) funds. The framework agreement is divided into two lots that reflect the thematic areas and priorities of Denmark’s Strategy for Development Cooperation: Lot 1: Climate, environment, private sector and financing. Lot 2: Governance, fragility, and migration. The framework agreement will require the provision of the following services pertaining to the design and implementation phases of bilateral development cooperation programmes, namely: Formulation of bilateral programmes and projects. This may include preparatory work in the formulation process if and as needed. Appraisal of the design of bilateral programmes and projects as a quality assurance milestone prior to approval. This includes external appraisals led by the consultant and early appraisals of larger or high-risk programmes/projects led by LÆRING. Review of bilateral programmes and projects under implementation. This can span inception, midterm and technical reviews covering the full implementation period of the programme/project as part of the MFA unit’s monitoring and reporting cycle. Reviews do not have the same scope of work, methodology and methods as an evaluation. The MFA’s definition of appraisal, review and evaluation services is aligned with the definitions provided by OECD/DAC (https://one.oecd.org/document/DCD/DAC/EV(2022)2/en/pdf). The content of the services will vary and be defined by the MFA in the specific Terms of Reference for each individual assignment. The following themes and types of services will not be part of the framework agreement: Research and university partnerships. Training programmes and tracer studies. Culture. NGO strategic partnership agreements with the MFA (SPA agreements). Core support to multilateral organisations as described in Danish Organisation Strategies. Strategic Sector Cooperation. Audit assignments. Legal assessments. Monitoring, evaluation, accountability and learning (MEAL) unit contracts and multi-year MEAL technical assistance. Evaluations. Tender process consultancies. Please refer to the Consultancy Framework Agreement and Appendix 1 Scope of Services for a more detailed description of the object of the procurement.

title: Killinmäen rakennusten purkusuunnittelu, kustannusarvio, rakennuttaminen ja purkutöiden valvonta
description: Killinmäen rakennusten purkusuunnittelu, kustannusarvio, rakennuttaminen ja purkutöiden valvonta Kirkkonummen kunta pyytää tarjouksia Killinmäen alueella osoitteessa Vanha Rantatie 254, 02400 Kirkkonummi sijaitsevien rakennusten purkusuunnittelusta, purku-urakan kustannusarvion laatimisesta, purku-urakan rakennuttamisesta sekä purkutöiden valvonnasta. Hankinnan kohteena olevien rakennusten yhteenlaskettu laajuus on noin 8 500 brm². Purkutyöt koskevat rakennuksia 1, 2 ja 4–9 sekä tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa määriteltyjä muita purettavia rakenteita. Rakennukset 3 ja 10 säilytetään, ja niiden teknisten järjestelmien sekä toimintaedellytysten säilyminen on huomioitava suunnittelussa ja purkutöiden toteutuksessa. Hankintaan sisältyvät tarvittavien lähtötietojen ja selvitysten kokoaminen, purkusuunnittelu, purkulupamenettelyyn liittyvät tehtävät, purkujäte- ja materiaalien hyödyntämisselvitykset, haitta-aine- ja asbestikartoitusten täydentäminen, pilaantuneen maaperän tutkimukset (PIMA), purku-urakan kustannusarvion laatiminen sekä purku-urakan kilpailuttamisen valmistelu ja rakennuttamistehtävät. Hankintaan sisältyvät lisäksi purku-urakan aikaiset rakennuttamis- ja turvallisuuskoordinaattorin tehtävät, työmaakokoukset, purkutöiden valvonta, dokumentointi sekä vastaanotto- ja luovutusvaiheen tehtävät. Hankinta toteutetaan yhtenä kokonaisuutena. Tarjottavan palvelun tulee sisältää kaikki tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä määritellyt tehtävät ja suoritteet. Hankinnan tarkempi sisältö, laajuus, aikataulu, hinnoitteluperusteet ja muut ehdot on esitetty tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa ja niiden liitteissä.,
